_doc: Delo Derby v3 board — UNIFIED race: the v2 carryover recipes (open-div4 / temp-16 / sgd-800, the v1 top-3) PLUS the prior-art levers mined from other implementations (KataGo / Gumbel / Leela), all raced wall-matched against a single C0 control on the PRODUCTION multiprocess recipe (run_sweep wave-mode, 1 trainer + 8 selfplay_workers, GPU-saturated => HONEST wall-clock). Engine 'run_sweep_wall_slice': each chunk advances an idea by ONE wall-time slice (slice_secs) via `python scripts/run_sweep.py --cell <CELL> --resume <idea>/checkpoints/latest.pt --max-wall-secs <slice_secs> --final-eval`; --final-eval writes a fresh eval/model_elo line INSIDE the bundle. Budget wall-native: an idea caps when wall_secs_total >= cap_wall_secs. Priority (Jason 2026-05-24) = NEVER-RUN/entry-fee first (every idea needs 2 elo points to have a Δelo/hr slope, so round-0 then round-1 run for all), THEN highest Δelo/HOUR (hill-climb the elo gradient — compute follows the steepest recent climb, not the highest absolute elo). Everyone caps; we CALL it early once decisive (v1 was called at 5/8). All cells share ONE base recipe (small / sims=400 / buf 1.5M / EMA 0.99 / sgd_per_position 0.0025 / temp 30 / wave 8x8) and change exactly ONE lever. The 'cell' key == the run_sweep.CELLS dict KEY; 'cell_name' == that Cell's .name (the sweep_runs/<cell_name>/checkpoints path the derby reads). All cells are already in run_sweep.CELLS. NOTE: derby-gumbel and derby-sims100 run at n_simulations=100 (gumbel's value-prop is good targets at CHEAP sims; sims100 is the plain-MCTS control to isolate whether gumbel rescues cheap sims). aux-head (opponent-reply) is a model-arch lever on its OWN axis/board, NOT in this search/recipe race.

ideas.name: c0
ideas.lever: CONTROL - no lever (small/sims400/EMA0.99/sgd0.0025/temp30); every other cell is read as a delta vs this

ideas.name: open-div4
ideas.lever: random_opening_moves=4 (WL3) - opening diversity; v1 ceiling winner (peak 1385)

ideas.name: forced
ideas.lever: KataGo Forced Playouts + policy-target pruning (k=2.0) - cheap root exploration without the sim tax

ideas.name: gumbel
ideas.lever: native Gumbel root + Sequential Halving at sims=100 - provably good targets at CHEAP sims (wall-fair native port; the generation-bound attack)

ideas.name: sims100
ideas.lever: CONTROL for gumbel - plain MCTS at sims=100, no gumbel (v1: floored at 389, never grokked); isolates whether gumbel rescues cheap sims

ideas.name: gumbel-fast5s
ideas.lever: A/B vs gumbel: SAME Gumbel@100 generator, but FIXED-STEP non-wave trainer (--sgd-steps-per-epoch 64, ~5s epochs, decoupled from inflow, can't run away) instead of wave+sgd_per_position - tests whether 'many faster epochs' climbs faster when gen floods
